title: Gardening
learning_outcomes: Explain soil light water in the context of gardening.
Compare and distinguish seasonal constraints in the context of gardening.
Apply garden design in the context of gardening.
Evaluate and justify decisions about pest management in the context of gardening.

lessons.title: Soil light water
lessons.outcome: Explain soil light water in the context of gardening.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving soil light water; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to container garden plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain soil light water from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of soil light water; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Seasonal constraints
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish seasonal constraints in the context of gardening.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving seasonal constraints; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to container garden plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain seasonal constraints from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of seasonal constraints; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Garden design
lessons.outcome: Apply garden design in the context of gardening.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving garden design; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to container garden plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain garden design from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of garden design; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Pest management
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about pest management in the context of gardening.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving pest management; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to container garden plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain pest management from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of pest management; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of soil light water; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of seasonal constraints; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of garden design; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of pest management; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
